Warranty: The successful bidder shall provide a minimum warranty of 3 (three) years from the d ate of completion of the anti-termite treatment. Coverage of Entire Campus: The anti-termite treatment shall be carried out throughout the entir e campus, covering all buildings, classrooms, laboratories, workshops, offices, corridors, storage are as, and other premises within the institutional campus. No area shall be left untreated. 3. Shifting of Furniture and Machinery: The contractor shall be solely responsible for arranging th e required manpower for shifting, moving, and repositioning furniture, equipment, machinery, and o ther movable items wherever necessary to carry out the treatment effectively. No additional charge s shall be paid by the institution for these activities. 4. Protection of Institutional Property: The contractor shall take all necessary precautions to prev ent damage to the institution's buildings, furniture, machinery, electrical installations, equipment, a nd other assets during the execution of the work. 5. Liability for Damages: Any damage, breakage, loss, or harm caused to institutional property due to the negligence, improper handling, or actions of the contractor or its personnel shall be the sole fi nancial responsibility of the contractor. The contractor shall repair or replace the damaged property at its own cost, or compensate the institution for the assessed financial loss. 6. Completion and Inspection: The work shall be considered complete only after treatment of the e ntire campus and satisfactory inspection by the authorized institutional representative. The contrac tor shall coordinate the work schedule with the institution to minimize disruption to regular activities.
